description: Whether what the recipient sees is a faithful, fast rendering of the document they were sent.

metrics.description: Visual similarity between a rendered preview page and the same page of the source.
metrics.measurementMethod: Render the source page and the served preview page to greyscale at a common size and compare with SSIM. A preview may be optimised for delivery, but must not alter content.
metrics.standardReference: Wang et al., Image quality assessment: from error visibility to structural similarity, IEEE TIP 13(4), 2004.

metrics.description: Share of the source page's words that are still legible in the rendered preview.
metrics.measurementMethod: Read the preview image back and compare its word set against the text extracted from the source page. Catches font substitution and cropping that a similarity score alone can miss.

metrics.description: Relative deviation between a preview page's aspect ratio and the source page's.
metrics.measurementMethod: abs(previewAspect - sourceAspect) / sourceAspect, over every rendered page. Detects accidental crop and rotation.

metrics.description: Preview pages served out of source order.
metrics.measurementMethod: Compare the ordinal sequence of stored page artifacts against the source page order and count inversions.

metrics.description: Largest Contentful Paint of the recipient viewer.
metrics.measurementMethod: Collected in the browser via the PerformanceObserver Largest Contentful Paint entry, reported at the 75th percentile across sessions.
metrics.standardReference: Google Web Vitals: LCP good <= 2.5s, needs improvement <= 4s (web.dev/lcp).

metrics.description: Interaction to Next Paint of the recipient viewer.
metrics.measurementMethod: Collected via the PerformanceObserver event timing entries, reported at the 75th percentile.
metrics.standardReference: Google Web Vitals: INP good <= 200ms, needs improvement <= 500ms (web.dev/inp).

metrics.description: Cumulative Layout Shift of the recipient viewer.
metrics.measurementMethod: Collected via the PerformanceObserver layout-shift entries excluding recent input, reported at the 75th percentile.
metrics.standardReference: Google Web Vitals: CLS good <= 0.1, needs improvement <= 0.25 (web.dev/cls).

metrics.description: Time from navigation to the first document page being painted.
metrics.measurementMethod: Marked in the client when the first page image decodes, relative to navigation start. The viewer must not wait for the whole document.

metrics.description: Critical or serious automated accessibility violations on any shipped surface.
metrics.measurementMethod: Run an automated axe-core scan over the recipient viewer, the sender app and the marketing pages, counting impact levels critical and serious. Automated scanning does not replace manual validation, but no known critical violation may ship.
